note: Gold SQL is written twice (semantic views, raw tables); the two are cross-checked for equal results by eval_nlsql.py --check-gold. unanswerable: success is a refusal.

questions.question: How many flights are in the corpus?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight

questions.question: How many events were recorded in total?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event

questions.question: How many flights had a motor failure detected?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'motor_failure_detected'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT e.flight_id) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'motor_failure_detected'

questions.question: How many failsafe events were there?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'failsafe_activated'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'failsafe_activated'

questions.question: How many distinct boards are in the data?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT board) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT metadata->>'sys_hw') FROM flight

questions.question: How many flights had both a takeoff and a landing event?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT flight_id FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'takeoff' INTERSECT SELECT flight_id FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'landing') x
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT e.flight_id FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'takeoff' INTERSECT SELECT e.flight_id FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'landing') x

questions.question: How many flights have no recorded events at all?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM semantic.events e WHERE e.flight_id = f.flight_id)
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event e WHERE e.flight_id = f.id)

questions.question: What is the average flight duration in minutes, to one decimal?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(avg(duration_s)::numeric / 60, 1) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(avg(duration_s)::numeric / 60, 1) FROM flight

questions.question: What is the median flight duration in seconds?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_s) FROM semantic.flights
questions.raw_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_s) FROM flight

questions.question: How many flights are longer than 10 minutes?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE duration_s > 600
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE duration_s > 600

questions.question: What percentage of flights had at least one critical event? One decimal.
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT flight_id) / (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights), 1) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT flight_id) / (SELECT count(*) FROM flight), 1) FROM event WHERE severity = 2

questions.question: Which board has the most flights?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT board FROM semantic.flights GROUP BY board ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT metadata->>'sys_hw' FROM flight GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the log id of the longest flight?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT log_id FROM semantic.flights ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT source_ref FROM flight ORDER BY duration_s DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the most common event kind?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT kind FROM semantic.events GROUP BY kind ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT c.key FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id GROUP BY c.key ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many critical events are there for each failure mode?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT failure_mode, count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2 AND failure_mode IS NOT NULL GROUP BY failure_mode
questions.raw_sql: SELECT fm.key, count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN concept_relation r ON r.src_id = c.id AND r.rel = 'indicates' JOIN concept fm ON fm.id = r.dst_id AND fm.kind = 'failure_mode' WHERE e.severity = 2 GROUP BY fm.key

questions.question: How many events happened in the first 10 seconds of a flight?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE start_s < 10
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE e.ts_start - f.started_at < interval '10 seconds'

questions.question: How many error messages from the autopilot mention the EKF?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE kind = 'log_error' AND description ILIKE '%ekf%'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id WHERE c.key = 'log_error' AND e.description ILIKE '%ekf%'

questions.question: How many events mention the word timestamp in their description?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE description ILIKE '%timestamp%'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event WHERE description ILIKE '%timestamp%'

questions.question: How many warning-level events are there?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity_label = 'warning'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event WHERE severity = 1

questions.question: Which board had the most vibration_high events?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT f.board FROM semantic.events e JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE e.kind = 'vibration_high' GROUP BY f.board ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT f.metadata->>'sys_hw' FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE c.key = 'vibration_high' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many battery_low events happened on flights of the PX4_FMU_V6X board?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.events e JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE e.kind = 'battery_low' AND f.board = 'PX4_FMU_V6X'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM event e JOIN concept c ON c.id = e.kind_id JOIN flight f ON f.id = e.flight_id WHERE c.key = 'battery_low' AND f.metadata->>'sys_hw' = 'PX4_FMU_V6X'

questions.question: What is the average number of critical events per flight, to two decimals?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights), 2) FROM semantic.events WHERE severity = 2
questions.raw_sql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / (SELECT count(*) FROM flight), 2) FROM event WHERE severity = 2

questions.question: How many flights did the pilot label with vibration as a cause?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE 'vibration' = ANY(pilot_error_labels)
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE metadata->'error_labels' @> '[2]'::jsonb

questions.question: How many flights did the pilot rate as good?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_rating = 'good'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE metadata->>'rating' = 'good'

questions.question: How many flights have written pilot feedback?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.flights WHERE pilot_feedback IS NOT NULL
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM flight WHERE btrim(coalesce(metadata->>'feedback', '')) <> ''

questions.question: How many flights recorded a battery voltage below 15 volts at some point?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'battery.voltage' AND min_value < 15
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'battery.voltage' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s WHERE lo < 15

questions.question: What is the highest accelerometer vibration value recorded in any flight?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT max(max_value) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'vibration.accel'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT max(hi) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'vibration.accel' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s

questions.question: How many flights had GPS horizontal accuracy worse than 5 meters at some point?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT flight_id) FROM semantic.signal_summary WHERE signal = 'gps.eph' AND max_value > 5
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'gps.eph' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s WHERE hi > 5

questions.question: Which flight had the highest battery voltage ever recorded? Give its log id.
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT f.log_id FROM semantic.signal_summary s JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE s.signal = 'battery.voltage' ORDER BY s.max_value DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT f.source_ref FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'battery.voltage' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s JOIN flight f ON f.id = s.flight_id ORDER BY s.hi DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which board had the highest average of its flights' peak vibration?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT f.board FROM semantic.signal_summary s JOIN semantic.flights f USING (flight_id) WHERE s.signal = 'vibration.accel' GROUP BY f.board HAVING count(*) >= 1 ORDER BY avg(s.max_value) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.raw_sql: SELECT f.metadata->>'sys_hw' FROM (SELECT t.flight_id, min(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS lo, max(t.value*m.scale+m."offset") AS hi FROM telemetry t JOIN field_mapping m ON m.vendor_field_id = t.vendor_field_id JOIN concept c ON c.id = m.concept_id AND c.kind = 'signal' WHERE c.key = 'vibration.accel' GROUP BY t.flight_id) s JOIN flight f ON f.id = s.flight_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg(s.hi) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What unit is the vibration.accel signal measured in?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT unit FROM semantic.signals WHERE signal = 'vibration.accel'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT unit FROM concept WHERE kind = 'signal' AND key = 'vibration.accel'

questions.question: How many canonical signals belong to the power subsystem?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM semantic.signals WHERE subsystem = 'power'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM concept s JOIN concept_relation r ON r.src_id = s.id AND r.rel = 'part_of' JOIN concept sub ON sub.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.kind = 'signal' AND sub.key = 'power'

questions.question: Which failure modes can the battery.voltage signal indicate?
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT related_concept FROM semantic.ontology WHERE concept = 'battery.voltage' AND relation = 'indicates'
questions.raw_sql: SELECT d.key FROM concept_relation r JOIN concept s ON s.id = r.src_id JOIN concept d ON d.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.key = 'battery.voltage' AND r.rel = 'indicates'

questions.question: List every subsystem that has at least one signal.
questions.semantic_sql: SELECT DISTINCT subsystem FROM semantic.signals WHERE subsystem IS NOT NULL
questions.raw_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sub.key FROM concept s JOIN concept_relation r ON r.src_id = s.id AND r.rel = 'part_of' JOIN concept sub ON sub.id = r.dst_id WHERE s.kind = 'signal' AND sub.kind = 'subsystem'
